unitOnFieldDefinition.specialTeams: excluded; possession does not identify kicking formations
unitOnFieldDefinition.unknown: null when a live unit cannot be determined

liveProbabilityModel.method: Player Normal increments with shared NFL-game effects

parameters.selectedBy: Lower combined 2023-2025 held-out matchup Brier than NIG; same means and variance

model.model: F315: native three-input regression + player forecast byes / matched NIG
model.mean_method: week-specific native three-input regression centered on observed league YTD PPG; forecast-week same-roster bye losses
model.weekly_volatility: league-wide normalized weekly SD; residual-matched to the bye-adjusted mean
model.strength_uncertainty: week-specific persistent Normal team offset, residual-matched to the bye-adjusted mean

potential_points.validation: 2023 selection; rolling 2024-2025 holdout; residual downward bias remains
